headline: A 2022 law directs the Small Business Administration to create a program that certifies some staff at Small Business Development Centers to give cybersecurity planning help to small businesses.
what_it_does: The law requires the Small Business Administration to set up a certification program for employees of Small Business Development Centers. Under the program, at least 5 or 10 percent of the total number of employees at each center would be certified. Certified employees would provide cybersecurity planning assistance to small businesses.

who_it_affects.how: They may be able to get cybersecurity planning help from certified staff at Small Business Development Centers.

who_it_affects.group: Employees of Small Business Development Centers
who_it_affects.how: Some of them would be certified to give cybersecurity planning assistance.
Each center would need to have a set share of its staff go through the new certification program.
The agency must create and run the certification program.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 27, 2022; the official summary does not state a separate effective date or deadlines for the program.
